description: This file defines the GenericResultWaiter class, which implements the GenericRequester interface to handle asynchronous service results and exceptions, providing methods to wait for completion and retrieve results or errors.

classes.name: GenericResultWaiter
classes.description: A class that waits for and handles the result or exception of an asynchronous service call, providing synchronization and status checking methods.

methods.name: receiveResult
methods.description: Handles successful result reception, updates status, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: receiveThrowable
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during service execution, updates status, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status code of the service.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the service has completed.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the exception thrown during service execution, if any.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the result map of the service if completed.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete, with a default timeout.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete, checking periodically every specified milliseconds.
